Join us at the Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat in Newbridge College, Co. Kildare. This is a donation-only event, with free buses available across the country and all meals included. Expect inspiring talks and workshops, Mass, music, prayer, and plenty of opportunities to chill out and meet other young Catholics. Whether you are new to the faith or looking to be refreshed, all are welcome. To register or find out more, visit youth2000.ie or follow @Youth2000Ireland.

Sunday 15th November at 4pm Conductor Gavin Maloney Soloist Cormac Ó h Aodáin, horn Richard Strauss : Horn Concerto No 1 Beethoven: Symphony No 6 (Pastoral) Tickets €15, Concessions €10 (available at Eventbrite or at the door) Dear parishioners, As the colder winter days arrive we are moving our Tuesday and
Thursday 10.00am Masses and our First Friday Mass into the warmth and comfort of the sacristy—beginning this
Tuesday 10th November. Tuesday and Saturday Eucharistic Adoration will also take place in the sacristy.
Gathering in a smaller space during the week al- lows us to be closer together in prayer while being responsible stewards of our parish resources.

Heating our large church for a small daily congre- gation requires the use of a lot of energy; by heating only the sacristy we can signiĮcantly re- duce our carbon footprint and save on gas and electricity costs.
Our Saturday evening Vigil Mass and our Sunday Masses will be celebrated in the church as normal.
